anchor_scope: the sender of atm task assign in atm-task-close.py and in atm-bd dispatch; notices keep ANC-042
anchor_statement: Every atm task assign that the close hook or atm-bd issues for a sanity or qa bead must run as the phase lead named in .atm-bd/phase-<x>.toml, set on that one subprocess, while every notice atm-bd sends keeps the constant sender atm-bd@tool.

cases.rationale: Approved pass fixture: assign runs as the lead from the phase file on that subprocess only; notices stay atm-bd@tool.
cases.text: The hook assigns the sanity bead with ATM_IDENTITY=team-lead taken from .atm-bd/phase-bj.toml on that subprocess only; its dev-complete send goes out as the dev and atm-bd's notices as atm-bd@tool.

cases.rationale: Approved fail fixture: assigning as the dev or as atm-bd@tool, or taking the lead from the process environment, is ruled out by the statement.
cases.text: The hook assigns the sanity bead as the dev, or atm-bd assigns it as atm-bd@tool, or the lead identity comes from the process environment instead of the phase file.

cases.rationale: Paraphrase of the statement for the atm-bd side, including the notice clause.
cases.text: atm-bd's dispatch runs atm task assign for each ready qa bead with ATM_IDENTITY set, in that one subprocess's environment, to the lead read from .atm-bd/phase-bj.toml; the ATM notices atm-bd sends still come from atm-bd@tool.

cases.rationale: Issues a qa assign (in scope) but says nothing about which identity it runs as; silence is not conflict.
cases.text: The sanity role of atm-task-close.py assigns the group's qa bead to quality-mgr with qa-template.xml.j2 and the shared vars file.

cases.rationale: Mentions the topic of sender identity without the directive's content.
cases.text: Sender identities for the hook's ATM commands are listed in the design notes; this item only adds the commands themselves.

cases.rationale: Process-wide identity makes notices leave as the lead, not atm-bd@tool, and is not set on the one assign subprocess.
cases.text: atm-bd exports ATM_IDENTITY=team-lead for its whole process at startup, so every assignment and every notice it sends comes from the lead.

cases.rationale: Notices must keep the constant sender atm-bd@tool.
cases.text: atm-bd sends its ready-bead notices with --as set to the phase lead.

cases.rationale: The lead must come from .atm-bd/phase-<x>.toml, not from the caller's environment (the fail fixture names this case).
cases.text: The close hook passes --as "$ATM_IDENTITY" taken from its own process environment when it assigns the sanity bead.

cases.rationale: Console icon rendering does not touch assignment identity.
cases.text: The console shows the sol icon next to every Codex agent of model sol in the agent list.
